name: zod2go
description: Use Zod schemas from TypeScript in Go with upstream compatibility

scripts.export:example: npm run build && node ts/dist/cli.js examples/schemas.ts UserSchema testdata/user.schema.json
scripts.export:extended: npm run build && node ts/dist/cli.js examples/schemas.ts ExtendedSchema testdata/extended.schema.json
scripts.export:fixtures: npm run export:example && npm run export:extended
scripts.test: npm run test:ts && npm run test:go
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm test && npm run check:inventory && npm run test:upstream && npm run test:upstream:native && npm run test:upstream:runtime && npm run check:upstream:coverage
